name: pdf_bench-docling
description: Benchmark for evaluating models on PDF document understanding tasks, including layout analysis, information extraction, and document question answering. It measures models' ability to parse multi-page PDFs, extract structured content, and answer document-centric queries that require combining visual layout and textual understanding. Designed to test robustness of document-oriented multimodal models.
reputation: Adopted by researchers in document understanding and DocVQA-style tasks; moderate niche adoption in the multimodal community.
